app.title: Status
screen.activity_tip: Posts heard from nearby stations. Write one below and it goes out on every radio this device has.
action.clear_feed_tip: Remove all posts currently in the feed
screen.search_tip: Search the statuses this station archived, by words or by callsign.
screen.following_tip: Callsigns you follow. The Following tab narrows the feed to them.
action.follow_add_tip: Type a callsign to follow. Their posts will show under Following.
field.follows_list_tip: Callsigns you follow. Tap a row to open it.
